title: Count Almost Equal Pairs II
summary: Count index pairs i < j where the two numbers become equal after at most two digit swaps in one of them, with leading zeros allowed.
officialConstraints: Not obtained in full (only the summary and a worked example were reached).
examples: [1023, 2310, 2130, 213] -> 4 (search summary, pair (1023, 2310) needs two swaps). The three-value example is illustrative (not from the statement).
visualizationNotes: Playback accepts 12 numbers up to 999999. Two-round swap reach per number; checked by an independent recursive search.
